info.title: MunicipalOS API
info.description: Public endpoints need no authentication and never return private data. Staff endpoints are scoped to one municipality in the URL; access requires an active staff membership there.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session token returned by POST /v1/auth/login.

get.summary: List municipalities that use MunicipalOS
Resolve a website hostname to a municipality
Public website data for a municipality
Service request categories a resident can choose

post.summary: Suggest a category for a description (keyword rules; advisory only)
Submit a non-emergency service request
post.description: Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string per submission) so a retried request does not create a duplicate. Emergencies must be reported by calling 911.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an earlier submission

get.summary: Track a request by its tracking number

post.summary: Add information to an open request
Add a photo to an open request
post.description: The image is re-encoded as JPEG and all metadata (including location) is removed. Up to 4 photos per request.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB

get.summary: Photo bytes for a request (requires its tracking number)
Published pages that appear in the website navigation
A published website page

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Development/test identity provider. Returns an opaque bearer token; only its hash is stored.

post.summary: Revoke the current session

The caller's membership and permissions in this municipality
Role-aware work queue and metrics
Departments of the municipality
List service requests visible to the caller
Request detail with full history

post.summary: Move a request to another workflow state

get.summary: Staff who may be assigned to this request

post.summary: Assign (or reassign) a request
Add an internal note or a resident-visible message
Add a photo (for example of the completed work). Visible to the resident.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB

get.summary: Photo bytes for a request the caller may see
The caller's in-app notifications

post.summary: Mark one or all of the caller's notifications as read

get.summary: Audit log for the municipality
Website pages with their publication state

post.summary: Create a page (starts as an empty draft)

get.summary: A page with its live, scheduled and working revisions and full history

put.summary: Save the draft (creates a new draft revision if the page has none)
put.description: `expectedVersion` must equal the draft's current `version` (or be null when no draft exists). A mismatch returns 409 `stale_draft` instead of overwriting someone else's edit. The published revision stays live while a draft is edited.

post.summary: Submit the draft for review
Approve the revision in review and publish it now or at a scheduled time
Send the revision in review back to draft with a note
Take a published page off the public site
Copy an archived page into a new draft (it must be reviewed again)

put.summary: Show or hide a page in the website navigation and set its order

get.summary: All announcements including drafts and expired ones

post.summary: Create an announcement as a draft

put.summary: Edit an announcement (published ones need content.publish)

post.summary: Publish an announcement, optionally until an end time
Stop showing a published announcement

get.summary: All service request categories, including inactive ones

post.summary: Create a category and choose the department it routes to

patch.summary: Edit, re-route, activate or deactivate a category
patch.description: Changing the department affects new requests only. Deactivating hides the category from residents; existing requests keep it.

get.summary: Branding, contact details and reporting policy
Staff of the municipality with their role, department and status
Roles and the permissions each grants (for access reviews)

patch.summary: Change a staff member's role, department, title or access status
patch.description: Nobody can change their own access. Suspending takes effect on the member's next request.

get.summary: Export the complete record of one service request as JSON
get.description: Includes reporter contact details, internal notes, the full history, photo metadata and notification delivery records. Requires `records.export`; every export is audited. Whether a record or part of it may be released is the municipality's legal decision — this endpoint only assembles it.

get.summary: Export the audit log as CSV
The municipality's retention schedule
get.description: A record type with no period set is kept permanently.

put.summary: Set how long closed service requests are kept, and the legal authority for it
put.description: `retentionDays: null` keeps records permanently. Changing the schedule never dispositions anything by itself.

get.summary: Legal holds on a request, including released ones

post.summary: Place a legal hold: the record cannot be dispositioned until every hold is released
Release a legal hold

get.summary: Closed requests whose retention period has passed and that are not on hold
get.description: A review list only. Nothing is dispositioned until an authorized person confirms specific records.

post.summary: Disposition specific records: permanently redact the reporter's personal data
post.description: Each record is re-checked: it must be closed, past the retention period, not on legal hold and not already dispositioned. The request's non-personal history is kept. This cannot be undone.
